import importlib.util, random, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

class FakeTime:
    def __init__(self): self.t = 0.0
    def monotonic(self):
        self.t += 100.0   # every call jumps far ahead -> budget expires immediately
        return self.t

orig = m.time
m.time = FakeTime()
random.seed(3)
ok = 0
for trial in range(200):
    npairs = random.randint(1, 15); n = random.randint(1, 12)
    items = []
    for i in range(n):
        mask = random.getrandbits(npairs) or 1
        items.append((mask, random.randint(1,50), "q%02d"%i))
    cov = 0
    for it in items: cov |= it[0]
    full = (1<<npairs)-1
    if cov != full: continue
    sol = m._solve_cover(items, full, npairs)
    exh = m._exhaustive_cover(items, full)
    assert sol is not None and exh is not None
    assert (sol[0], sol[1]) == (exh[0], exh[1]), (trial, sol, exh)
    ok += 1
m.time = orig
print("forced-fallback path verified on", ok, "instances")
PYEOF
